title: Foundation and Empire
author: Isaac Asimov
summary: Second in Asimov's classic series. The Foundation, created to shorten a coming galactic dark age, meets its first major outside threats, and the plan its founder drew up is tested in ways he may not have foreseen.
readIf: you like idea-driven classic science fiction told as a sweep of history rather than one hero's story.
skipIf: you want character-driven drama, as the people change every few chapters.

pairings.reason: The first book in the series, which sets up the plan and characters you need here.
Another classic that treats empire, prophecy and political forces on a vast scale.
A later, more literary space epic about the long arc of human civilisation.
